items.original_audit_text: F_{p²} curves: FourQ and the GLS class. items.original_audit_text: Dinur's polynomial method and the Lokshtanov et al. beyond-brute-force family for Boolean systems. The corpus cites Dinur only for time-space tradeoffs. The required exponent is c < 1/2 − 1/m and the published c ≈ 0.69 does not reach it, but the descended systems are Frobenius-linear in most monomials and their effective exponent is unmeasured. Run it on the n ≤ 41 systems and fit c. Expected negative, cheap, and it closes a whole paradigm.
